newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real rises 0.01 pct in listless trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real rises 0.01 pct in listless trade.

text.p: Brazil's real rose a slight 0.01 percent to end at 1.0275 per dollar in listless trade in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
"It's the first week of the month. Trading will be calm because bankers are just beginning to build up positions for the end of the month," a dealer said.

In late afternoon trade, the Central Bank bought dollars at 1.0275 real per greenback to drain excess dollars from the market. Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Monday surplus of around $15 million.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real ended steady at 1.0331 to the dollar.
In the illegal parallel market, the real closed rose 0.46 percent to close at 1.090 per greenback, traders said.
